item.title: Publications
item.description:
Preprints

  1. Simple generators of rational function fields. preprint, 2026.
    Alexander Demin and Gleb Pogudin.

  2. Reading Rational Univariate Representations on lexicographic Groebner bases. preprint, 2024.
    Alexander Demin, Fabrice Rouillier, and Joao Ruiz.

  3. Groebner.jl: A package for Groebner bases computations in Julia. preprint, 2024.
    Alexander Demin and Shashi Gowda.

Journal Papers (Peer-Reviewed)

  1. Redactable blockchains and polynomial equations. Advances in Applied Mathematics 181 (2026) 103149.
    Alexander Demin, Alexey Ovchinnikov, and Vladimir Shpilrain.

  2. Factoring sparse polynomials fast. Journal of Complexity 88 (2025) 101934. preprint
    Alexander Demin and Joris van der Hoeven.
